topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I've been mulling over the neighbor’s fence, the way it looms in conversations, a shadow cast over the garden even before the first post is driven into the ground. It’s not just a boundary, you see—it’s a statement, a shift in the landscape of our little corner of the world. I find myself wondering about the quiet mornings, the way the sunlight used to spill freely into the yard. Will it change the way the wind whispers through the trees, the way the shadows play on the walls? I keep thinking I should speak to him, share my thoughts, but the words tangle in my throat, like leaves caught in the autumn breeze. Maybe it’s best to let the fence rise and see what the new shape of our neighborhood will be.
